instruction: Resize the canvas to 1024x1024 pixels and export the image as /home/user/Desktop/canvas_output.png.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully created a new layer named 'Square' in GIMP by right-clicking the layers panel, selecting New Layer, clearing the default name, typing 'Square', and clicking OK. Completed in 6 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate GIMP layer context menus, open New Layer dialog, edit layer name field, confirm dialog
metadata.task_rationale: Tests canvas resize (Image > Canvas Size) which is a different dialog from Scale Image, plus export. Canvas resize changes the canvas without resampling the image content.
metadata.explanation: Task requires resizing the 800x800 canvas to 1024x1024 and exporting as PNG. Evaluator downloads the exported PNG from VM and checks its dimensions are exactly 1024x1024.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter vm_file correctly fetches the exported file from /home/user/Desktop/canvas_output.png, verifying both that the file exists at the correct path and that it can be analyzed.
Metric check_image_size correctly opens the image and compares width/height against expected 1024x1024, returning 1.0 on match and 0.0 otherwise.
Both instruction requirements are covered: (1) canvas resized to 1024x1024 is verified by dimension check, (2) export to correct path is verified by the file fetch succeeding.
Parameter handling is correct: expected.type='rule' means the metric receives {'width': 1024, 'height': 1024} as the rule parameter, which it accesses via rule.get('width') and rule.get('height').
Null handling is correct: if the file doesn't exist on the VM, getter returns None, and check_image_size returns 0.0 for None src_path.
